About HP 

 
 
 At HP, you’ll have a chance to create tools, technology, and solutions that reshape the way the world works in the future. If you’re looking to join a company that allows you to connect with a network of professionals eager to support you in doing your best work, we want to talk to you. Our legendary culture guides every employee toward success—fostering collaboration and driving innovation.

 Operating in over 170 countries, HP is always creating new services, products, and capabilities giving you more opportunities to advance your career. Here, innovation is the key to professional development and career mobility.

 When you join HP, you’re joining a company that believes every voice matters and that we all deserve a seat at the table. From the boardroom to factory floor, we create a culture where everyone is respected and where people can be themselves. You will be part of a global laboratory where different perspectives and experiences will help you solve problems in new ways. This is where you can build a long and wide-ranging career.





 
 
 About the role 

 The Security Platform Engineer owns the reusable platform capabilities that embed security and compliance into our development and delivery workflows. You will build and run the security tooling, test environments, and processes that keep our Android- and Linux-based devices secure, from code scanning in CI to penetration testing on real hardware.

 You will own our vulnerability management process end to end: generating SBOMs, triaging reported vulnerabilities, assessing their impact on our products, and driving fixes through to release. You will report to the Platform Engineering manager and work closely with the Infrastructure & Automation Technical Lead, product development teams, and HP security.

 About the team 

 Platform Engineering builds and runs the developer platform behind Poly Video products, built on PolyOS, our Android-based OS. We own the path from commit to validated release: source control, CI/CD, build compute and storage, artifact management, and automated testing.

 Key tools and technologies you'll work with:

 
 GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions

 Python

 Android and Linux builds

 SBOM and vulnerability scanning tools

 Static analysis and code scanning (SonarQube)

 Penetration testing and network analysis tools

 Docker, Proxmox, and VM infrastructure

 
 What you'll do 

 Vulnerability management 

 
 Own intake, triage, and tracking of reported vulnerabilities, from CVE feeds, scanners, customers, and researchers

 Assess exploitability and impact on our products, and recommend next steps: patch, mitigate, or document as not affected

 Drive fixes with development teams and track them through to release

 Produce vulnerability status reports and advisories for engineering and leadership

 
 SBOM and software composition 

 
 Generate and maintain SBOMs for every product release, covering Android, Linux, and third-party components

 Automate SBOM generation and vulnerability matching in the build pipeline

 Support open-source license compliance and third-party component reviews

 
 Security in the development pipeline 

 
 Build reusable GitHub Actions workflows for static analysis, dependency scanning, and secrets detection

 Define and enforce security gates on pull requests and release builds

 Tune scanners to reduce noise so developers act on real findings

 
 Device security testing 

 
 Design and maintain isolated penetration testing environments for our devices

 Perform hands-on penetration testing of devices, network services, web interfaces, and APIs

 Automate recurring security tests and integrate them with our hardware test lab

 Report findings clearly, with severity, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance

 
 Compliance 

 
 Support EU Cyber Resilience Act readiness, including SBOM and vulnerability-handling obligations

 Support FIPS and Common Criteria certification efforts with evidence, testing, and documentation

 Partner with HP security teams on policy, audits, and coordinated disclosure

 
 Required qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field

 4+ years in product security, application security, DevSecOps, or security engineering

 Hands-on vulnerability management: CVE triage, CVSS scoring, exploitability assessment, and remediation tracking

 Experience generating and analyzing SBOMs (SPDX or CycloneDX) and using software composition analysis tools

 Hands-on penetration testing of network services, web interfaces, or APIs, with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, or Metasploit

 Python scripting for security automation

 Experience integrating security scanning into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar)

 Clear written communication, including findings reports for both engineers and leadership

 
 Preferred qualifications 

 
 Android platform security: SELinux policy, verified boot, app sandboxing, and Android security bulletins

 Embedded or IoT device security testing, including hardware interfaces (UART, JTAG) and firmware analysis

 Experience with EU Cyber Resilience Act, FIPS 140-3, or Common Criteria

 Strong Linux skills, including networking, services, and system hardening

 SBOM and vulnerability tools such as Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track, or Black Duck

 Static analysis and code scanning tools such as SonarQube, CodeQL, or Semgrep

 Fuzzing tools and techniques (AFL++, libFuzzer, or protocol fuzzers)

 Experience with VEX statements and coordinated vulnerability disclosure

 Security certifications such as OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CISSP

 
 Salary Range: $111,400-$161,550 





  
 Compensation & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)
 

 The salary range for this role is listed above. Final salary offered is based upon multiple factors including individual job-related qualifications, education, experience, knowledge and skills.

 At HP, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:

 
 Health insurance

 Dental insurance

 Vision insurance

 Long term/short term disability insurance

 Employee assistance program

 Flexible spending account

 Life insurance

 Generous time off policies, including; 
 
 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure

 11 paid holidays

 Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )

 


 
 Why join HP? 

 When you join HP, you’re investing in your future—and so are we. You have priorities beyond work. That’s why we offer flexibility, support, and benefits that help you shape the life you want.  

 Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO) Statement 

 HP, Inc. provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and prospective employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, age, disability, or status as a protected veteran, marital status, familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic predisposition or carrier status, uniformed service status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable national, federal, state, and local law(s).

 Please be assured that you will not be subject to any adverse treatment if you choose to disclose the information requested. This information is provided voluntarily. The information obtained will be kept in strict confidence.
